column1: # CORRECTION: the row below was a FALSE ENTRY and nothing was deleted for it.
# `origin` is the SHORT name of refs/remotes/origin/HEAD (the symbolic default-branch

# correctly failed with "remote ref does not exist".  59 branches were actually deleted.
